narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The sides cannot be equal, because a square is not a rectangle.
<bookmark mark='square'/>A rectangle needs four right angles, and a square has all of them.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Its opposite sides are equal too, so a square is a special kind of rectangle.
